source: Recorded 2026-11-01 from cua's host: the cua plugin 0.20.5 (commit 18cad987) in client mode, its browser service's create_tab and then tab_screenshot (the tab's first CDP use, then a later one), against cua's own fake MAWS peer (test/helpers/fake-maws-peer.mjs) answering as its contract test 4 does (test/chrome-client-mode-contract.test.mjs, cua #251). Each entry is one frame cua wrote to the MAWS socket: a primitive, or a debugger.sendCommand on the tab's own session by its CDP method and params. P5 O17 M2 replays it through MAWS's primitive server (src/main/browser/cua/event-scope.test.ts).
